intent: Ten original practice-notice tasks distinguish exercise from live warning, retain pre-session explanation and questions, sort exact instructions into named Before/During/After slots, reject bag/video interruptions, keep staff supervision when separated, review clarity, retain unknown actual signal/meeting point and current local emergency guidance. Fresh new-student transfer changes the situation and tests partly correct plans across stages.
picturePurpose: Exact code-labelled stage slots organise source instructions without inventing an evacuation map, actual signal, meeting point or emergency procedure. A generated scene would not supply the missing school-specific facts.

items.material:
OUR SCHOOL PRACTICE SESSION
This is a notice about a planned safety exercise, not a live warning. Before the session, your teacher will explain the current school plan, the agreed signal and the meeting point. Listen carefully and ask if you are unsure. During the exercise, follow staff instructions and keep the route clear. Do not return for a bag or stop to make a video. If you become separated, tell a member of staff rather than leaving the supervised area alone. After the exercise, the class will discuss which instructions were clear and which need explaining again. A practice session is useful when it helps people understand a plan. It is not a race to see who can reach the meeting point first. Actual emergencies require current local guidance, not assumptions based only on a classroom text.

transfer.stem: Which plan follows all three stages of the notice?
transfer.passage:
A FICTIONAL NEW-STUDENT PRACTICE
A planned school exercise is about to begin. Lina has joined the class recently and is unsure about the agreed signal and meeting point. This classroom notice does not name either of them. Staff will explain the current arrangements before the exercise, and Lina should ask about anything unclear. During practice, students follow staff instructions, keep the route clear and stay within supervision. They should not stop to make a video. Afterwards, the class discusses which instructions need explaining again, rather than ranking the fastest arrivals. An actual emergency still requires current local guidance.

options.text: Ask staff to confirm the arrangements, follow their instructions during practice, and discuss unclear instructions afterwards.
Ask staff about the meeting point, but stop during practice to make a video for the review.
Keep the route clear during practice, but use the review to rank who arrived fastest instead of checking clarity.

answer.display: Ask staff to confirm the arrangements, follow their instructions during practice, and discuss unclear instructions afterwards.

explanation.strategy: 按演练前、中、后分别核对；一项做对，不能抵消另一个阶段违反要求。

steps.text: Lina不清楚信号和集合点，演练前应请工作人员确认，不从本文猜具体安排。
steps.reason: 通知没有给出这两项实际细节，staff will explain与ask about anything unclear要求向工作人员问清。

steps.text: 演练中服从指令、不停下拍视频；结束后讨论仍不清楚的指令，不按到达速度排名。
steps.reason: 三个阶段的要求要同时满足；真实紧急情况还需要当前当地指引，不能只套用课堂通知。

distractors.reason: 开始前提问正确，却为回顾而在演练中停下拍视频，与明确的不拍视频要求冲突。
